extracted.intended_audience: astronomers, observatory staff, and researchers using historical observational records
extracted.subtask_description: Recording and reporting observational measurements for stellar culminations, including instrument readings (barometer, thermometer, microscopes), applied corrections (refraction and reduction), computed half-differences and means, and counts of observations used to derive final mean positions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Barom.
rubrics_metrics.description: Barometer readings (expressed in inches) recorded for each observation/date (column heading 'Barom.' and 'inches.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values (e.g. 29.75, 30.20, 29.93) are given beside each date/observation and are used together with 'Refract, and Reduct.' corrections; must be recorded for each observation to permit atmospheric refraction corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Therm.
rubrics_metrics.description: Thermometer (temperature) readings recorded for each observation (column heading 'Therm.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Temperature values (e.g. 54, 60, 57.5) accompany the barometer readings and are reported per observation; used with barometric pressure for refraction/reduction calculations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Microscopes (I., II., III., IV.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Measurements from four microscopes/instrument channels are recorded in separate columns labeled I., II., III., IV. under 'Microscopes.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each microscope column contains multiple numeric sub-entries per observation (e.g. sequences like '22 13 28.3'); these per-microscope readings are used to compute the 'Mean of 4 Microscopes.' and to assess internal consistency across instrument channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refract, and Reduct.
rubrics_metrics.description: Refraction and reduction corrections applied to the raw observations, shown under the label 'Refract, and Reduct.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Corrections are listed (often as paired negative/positive values such as '-31.1 31.1' or small numeric corrections like '-5 1.2' / '5 1.2'); these indicate the magnitude and sign of corrections to be applied to observed values for refraction and for reduction to a standard reference (epoch).

rubrics_metrics.name: Superior Culminat.
rubrics_metrics.description: Superior culmination values (times/angles) recorded for the star/observation (label 'Superior Culminat.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Displayed in the sections for each star (e.g. 'Superior Culmination.' followed by numeric entries). These represent the observed superior culmination measurements used in final position computations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inferior Culminat.
rubrics_metrics.description: Inferior culmination values (times/angles) recorded for the star/observation (label 'Inferior Culminat...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Analogous to superior culmination entries; inferior culmination readings are reported and used alongside superior culminations and corrections to derive mean positions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Half Diff. S. P. D.
rubrics_metrics.description: Half Difference S. P. D. — a tabulated metric listed as 'Half Diff. S. P. D.' for observation sets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values appear under the heading 'Half Diff. S. P. D.' (or variants) and are reported for each set (e.g. numbers like '21 57 56.4' contexts exist); used as an internal measure (half-difference) contributing to dispersion/error assessment when combining observations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mean of 4 Microscopes.
rubrics_metrics.description: The computed mean across the four microscope channels, given as 'Mean of 4 Microscopes.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page repeatedly reports 'Mean of 4 Microscopes.' with derived values (e.g. 'Mean of 4 Microscopes . 21° 57' 59".1 by 20 Observ.'); this summarizes per-observation central estimate across instrument channels and is used as the basis for final reported values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mean (sectional / date-specific)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sectional or date-specific mean values indicated by lines labeled '... Mean ...' summarizing groups of readings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: '. . . Mean . . .' rows present aggregated summary values across observations or microscopes for that date or group (often preceding/replacing detailed per-microscope lines). These means are intermediate summaries used in further reduction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mean S. P. D. of [star], Jan. 1, 1828 (by N Observ.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Final mean S. P. D. (star positional datum) for a given star at epoch (e.g. 'Mean S. P. D. of y Trianguli, Jan. 1, 1828 . 21° 57' 56".63 by 47 Observ.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each star the report gives a computed mean position (with degrees, minutes, seconds), the epoch (Jan. 1, 1828), and the number of observations used. This is the final reduced value reported for that star.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ann. Var. (Annual Variation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual variation for the star labeled 'Ann. Var.' with a numeric value (e.g. 'Ann. Var. — 10".554').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported alongside the star's name/heading (e.g. 'g Piscis Volantis. (Ann. Var. — 10".554.)'); indicates the star's annual variation (used for secular corrections or context).

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of Observations (by N Observ.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of observations used to compute means or final values, indicated with phrases like 'by 4 Observ.' or 'by 47 Observ.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each final mean or 'Mean of 4 Microscopes' is annotated with the number of observations used (e.g. 'by 20 Observ.'), which documents sample size for the reported mean and is critical for assessing reliability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refract. ... Mean ... and Reduct. (combined reporting format)
rubrics_metrics.description: Combined reporting rows that show refraction, mean, and reduction in sequence (format 'Refract. ... Mean ... and Reduct.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sections frequently present a block with 'Refract, and Reduct.' then '-X Y' and then 'Superior Culminat.' etc.; this is the standard presentation format for listing applied corrections, interim mean, and reduced quantities in the observation tables.
